svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="YaUEnbV5tXz7OKXpOjIy"> <mxGraphModel dx="1585" dy="925" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml Deployment Diagram - BrewLite Production Environment (Vertical)

skinparam BackgroundColor #FFFFFF
skinparam Shadowing false
skinparam DefaultFontName \"Arial\"
skinparam DefaultFontSize 12
skinparam DefaultFontColor #202124
skinparam ranksep 40
skinparam nodesep 40

skinparam componentStyle uml2 
skinparam frameStyle rectangle 

top to bottom direction

title Sơ đồ Triển khai Hạ tầng BrewLite (Vertical Deployment Diagram) 

cloud \"Internet Public Network\" as internet 

' --- 1. MÔI TRƯỜNG LOCAL & CI/CD ---
rectangle \"Development & CI/CD Environments\" {
 node \"Local Development Environment\" as local_env {
 artifact \"Docker Compose\n(Local Web, API & DB)\" as local_docker
 }

 node \"Hạ tầng CI/CD (GitHub Actions)\" as github_env { 
 frame \"GitHub Actions Runner\n(CI/CD Pipeline: lint, test, build)\" as gh_actions 
 database \"GitHub Container Registry (GHCR)\" as ghcr { 
 artifact \"BrewLite API Docker Image\n(Tagged SHA / Semver)\" as docker_img 
 } 
 }
}

' --- 2. MÔI TRƯỜNG PRODUCTION ---
rectangle \"Production Environment (Cloud Hosting)\" {
 node \"Thiết bị Khách hàng (Client Device)\" as user_device { 
 node \"Mobile / Desktop Browser\" as browser { 
 artifact \"Next.js Web Client App\n(apps/web - Order Ahead)\" as next_client 
 } 
 } 

 node \"Frontend Hosting Node (Vercel)\" as fe_node { 
 component \"Next.js Production Build\n(Static / SSR)\" as fe_app 
 } 
 
 node \"Backend API Node (Render Web Service)\" as be_node { 
 component \"NestJS REST API App\n(apps/api - Port 3001/3000)\" as be_api 
 interface \"GET /health\" as health_endpoint 
 be_api - health_endpoint 
 } 
 
 node \"Database Server Node (Render Managed PostgreSQL)\" as db_node { 
 database \"PostgreSQL Database\n(Persistent Storage Volume)\" as postgres_db 
 }

 node \"Logging & Monitoring Services\" as log_node {
 component \"Vercel Logs & Render Logs\" as cloud_logs
 }
}

' --- KẾT NỐI MẠNG & GIAO THỨC ---
user_device -- internet : HTTPS (443) 
internet --> fe_node : HTTPS (Web Client) 
internet --> be_node : HTTPS (API Requests) 

' Internal Service Connections 
fe_node --> be_node : Client-side API Calls (CORS) 
be_node --> db_node : Internal TCP (Port 5432) 

' CI/CD Pipeline Flow 
gh_actions --> ghcr : Build & Push Docker Image
github_env --> be_node : Trigger Render Deploy Hook

' Log Collection Connections
fe_node ..> cloud_logs : Logs
be_node ..> cloud_logs : Logs

@enduml",
 "config": null
